prompt:
Lexkite – English learning app (IELTS · TOEIC · TOEFL · CEFR) shipped in 15 UI languages incl. German, Russian, Vietnamese, Arabic (RTL): design every label for +40% longer text, wrap instead of truncating, never shrink buttons. Use the project design system (Lexkite Kit / Tactile Gamified Prep): Plus Jakarta Sans, deep teal #0F3D3E brand, coral CTA with tactile bottom ledge, cream light background, rounded 16-24px cards. App shell: mobile bottom tab bar with exactly 5 tabs Today, Vocab, Skills, Tests, Me; desktop left sidebar with the same 5 items. No hearts or lives anywhere. No photos and no drawn people: where the teacher appears, leave an empty rounded placeholder labelled "teacher-slot" (the 2D teacher Ama or Carlos is inserted by code). Material Symbols Rounded icons. Every tap target at least 44x44 px, text contrast at least 4.5:1, icons at least 3:1. Realistic content, no lorem ipsum.

Screen (mobile 390px, light theme): the Streak screen, an INNER screen (back arrow 44 px + title "Streak", one help icon right, no bottom tabs). Feel: warm, proud and calm like a cosy fireplace – it celebrates showing up, never guilt-trips. Top hero: a big glowing flame illustration with the streak number "14" large beneath it and a "day streak" label, and a small teacher-slot card beside it with a short kind speech bubble "Nice rhythm – one small lesson keeps it going." Then a "This week" strip of 7 day circles: past learned days filled warm orange with a flame, one frozen day icy blue with a snowflake, TODAY outlined in coral with a dot and the label "Today", future days soft and empty. Then a compact month calendar card (November 2026) with the same three states, a tiny legend (Learned, Frozen, Today) and month arrows. Then a "Streak freeze" card: 1 of 2 freezes ready shown as ice-cube icons, text "Protects your streak if you miss a day. Earn one free every 7 days." Then a "Next milestone: 30 days" card with a progress bar 14/30 and a "Gift chest" reward chip, plus a row "1 chest ready" with an Open button. Then a "Daily goal" card: today's ring 14/20 XP and a 3-option segmented choice Casual 5 min, Regular 10 min (selected), Intense 20 min. Then an "Event: collect 5 leaves" row with 5 leaf icons (2 filled) and a "Collection" row linking to frames and stickers (chevron). One full-width coral primary button pinned at the bottom: "Continue learning". Generous spacing and clear hierarchy: the number and today's state read in one glance. Quality bar (hard): every text at least 4.5:1 contrast in this theme (no light-grey or low-opacity small text, no white text on light chips); every button, link, chip, icon button and input at least 44 px tall with clear spacing; icons only from the Material Symbols set with real names; no horizontal overflow at 390 px; in the dark theme no white or very light cards or panels. Frame (Lexkite §5d): phone 390 px; top bar is one of three fixed variants – hub screen: title left + one icon action right, with the 5 bottom tabs; inner screen: back arrow (44 px) + title, no bottom tabs; lesson/focus screen: close X (44 px) top left + slim progress bar, no tabs, one full-width primary button pinned at the bottom. 16 px side gutter, one primary button per screen.

Convert this exact screen to the dark theme. Keep the identical layout, components and every text string. Page background #10191B, cards #172427, raised surfaces #1E2F33, primary text #E8F1F0, secondary text #A9BDBB, brand teal accents lightened for contrast; keep the coral CTA. Text contrast at least 4.5:1, icon contrast at least 3:1, no large light panels or white cards. Quality bar (hard): every text at least 4.5:1 contrast in this theme (no light-grey or low-opacity small text, no white text on light chips); every button, link, chip, icon button and input at least 44 px tall with clear spacing; icons only from the Material Symbols set with real names; no horizontal overflow at 390 px; in the dark theme no white or very light cards or panels.
